cases.mechanism_detail: AluYa5 inserted into DMD exon 59 introduces two stop codons and a poly(A) tract; ESE prediction suggested no effect on exon 59 splicing, so the insertion is predicted to be retained in mRNA and truncate dystrophin. Mother and sister are carriers.
cases.quote: The two stop codons and polyA tail likely terminate translation, preventing the production of functional dystrophin protein, which may be the mechanism leading to DMD.
